correctness.rationale: PASS. In Frobenius R^{ab}, the product of a row simplices has center 1/(b+1) and independent b-by-b shape blocks S_b=((b+1)I−J)/[b(b+1)^2]. Its n_j=−e_j and n_{b+1}=ones support contacts, with weights b/(b+1), satisfy both John moment conditions in every row, hence certify the unrestricted product John ellipsoid. A column cap has exact support (a+√a)/(b+1), so Q_ab retains the same ellipsoid iff b+1≥a+√a, equivalent to b≥a+ceil√a−1. At equality all column facets tangent (a must be square). Below threshold the candidate is infeasible; if the actual John ellipsoid had slack column caps, column-symmetry makes all slack and moving its center and positive-definite shape toward the row John ellipsoid would preserve feasibility for small epsilon while strictly increasing logdet, contradiction. Spectrum and volume follow from S_b eigenvalues and determinant. Independent exact rational supports and thresholds checked 144 (a,b) cases; analytic John certificate and logdet establish the unrestricted integers.
